messages:
zoe_sales: MidCap Retail procurement just emailed asking for an "assurance packet" for their POC. They want SOC 2 Type II evidence, ISO 27001 snapshot, and a signed pen-test attestation they can file. They said no raw vuln data. Need by EOD Wednesday. Can we assemble?

hassan_se: We can. Assets available: redacted SOC2 PDF (2024), ISO cert image, pen-test executive summary from ForgeSec. They only want attestation + remediation summary, not the full report. Also request a diagram showing Private deployment KMS isolation.

mei_compliance: I can assemble the packet and draft a one-page attestation. Questions: 1) Do they need the pen-test engagement dates in the attestation? 2) Do they require SLA language around uptime for the POC? Legal will need to sign. I can produce a draft in 12 hours if I get the remediation notes.

lucas_engineering: For the KMS language, use: `Customer-managed keys remain within the customer VPC; Redwood does not export or hold private keys.` Add: `Audit logs are retained per customer configuration and can be exported on request.` I'll attach a small architecture SVG to the packet.

zoe_sales: Procurement also wants a one-line on pricing: whether Dedicated trial pricing differs from hosted for the POC. Keep it high-level: "Dedicated trial pricing available; contact sales for short-term commit options and pricing."

mei_compliance: Draft attestation text: [Date]
To whom it may concern,
Redwood Inference confirms that a third-party penetration test (ForgeSec) covering the Redwood inference control plane and relevant hosting components was performed on [engagement dates]. No unresolved critical findings remain open as of [remediation date]; a remediation summary is included. The full report is restricted; this attestation and the attached remediation summary are provided for vendor assurance.
Sincerely,
Redwood Inference - Compliance

evidencebot: Evidence ticket created: EVID-4622 assigned to mei_compliance. Due 1933409999.

mei_compliance: I'll stage the POC packet to secure presign and include: 1) SOC2_TypeII_redacted.pdf, 2) ISO27001_cert.jpg, 3) Attestation_draft.pdf (pending legal signature), 4) Remediation_summary.pdf, 5) Private_arch_diagram.svg, 6) Pricing_note.txt, 7) Telemetry_statement.txt.

jules_legal: Legal will review the attestation wording. If the customer requests the full pen-test report we require an executed NDA and redaction process. Approving the attestation with engagement dates and remediation confirmation is standard.

mei_compliance: Uploading presigned ZIP (internal only, expires 7 days): https://internal-s3.redwood.net/presign/EVID-4622/midcap-poc-packet.zip?exp=7d

zoe_sales: I'll send the presigned link to MidCap procurement and confirm whether they need legal countersign before download. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
